video_title: Coach Daigneault on Team Effort and Team Win | Postgame Media | October 22, 2026

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the team's defensive execution against Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: the job we did on Jokic and Murray specifically is what won us the game
quotes.quote: For us that was a game plan win in terms of execution. The job we did on Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray specifically is what won us the game. They miss some shots they can make obviously, but we made them earn everything. It was about as clean of a game plan execution as you can have, especially this early in the season.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault credited the Thunder win to defensive execution against Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray. He noted it was about as clean of a game plan execution as you can have this early in the season.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault discusses the defensive execution of the Thunder against Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray following the team's victory.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's leadership and self-awareness
quotes.excerpt: he asked out of the game at the end of the game, and he's got a historic streak going
quotes.quote: He asked out of the game at the end of the game, and he's got a historic streak going, which is a remarkable streak obviously. And I just think for the class that it shows, and the perspective that it shows, for him to say, 'Hey, I'm out now, the game's calling for me to be subbed out of the game.' That was his substitution. And of all the things that I admire about him, that's towards the top of the list in terms of moments that I appreciate about him.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault praised Shai Gilgeous-Alexander for his self-awareness after the star asked to be subbed out despite his historic scoring streak. Daigneault called the move a moment that shows his class and perspective.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault praises Shai Gilgeous-Alexander for his self-awareness and leadership in asking to be substituted out of the game.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren's growth and impact as a lob threat
quotes.excerpt: he got us to the bonus like three or four minutes into the quarter just on his gravity
quotes.quote: In the second half, we were really looking for him in the fourth quarter and he got us to the bonus like three or four minutes into the quarter just on his gravity. I thought there were some of those plays where we could have found him in the first half. I thought there were some of the plays we could have gone and finished in the second half because his man kind of stuck to him. All that will come, but he's doing everything we're asking him to do. These are two really high-level games that he just played critical minutes in.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says Chet Holmgren is doing everything asked of him, highlighting the gravity Holmgren provides as a lob threat and his ability to get the team into the bonus early in the fourth quarter.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault evaluates Chet Holmgren's offensive growth and his impact as a lob threat during the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren's defensive impact against Victor Wembanyama and Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: the block he had, I thought really swung the game. That was a huge momentum play for us
quotes.quote: He's just such a monster competitor and the block he had, I thought really swung the game. That was a huge momentum play for us. It came after he had two straight turnovers that he was frustrated with. Him making that play in that moment when the game's not going the way that we want it to go, he wants it to go offensively, he's got some fouls, that embodies who he is.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault praised Chet Holmgren for his resilience after a key block swung momentum in the Thunder win. Daigneault said the play embodies who Holmgren is as a monster competitor.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault highlights Chet Holmgren's competitive nature and defensive impact after a key block late in the game.
